title: Melody Forge
description: Melody Forge — a Minecraft mod that adds crafting recipes for all music discs using a new item called Record Blank.
body:
📰 Melody Forge opens a new musical dimension in Minecraft, allowing players to craft every music disc themselves.

✨ Key Features
Crafting recipes for all music discs:

New item: Record Blank — a base material used to craft any disc.

🎵 How It Works
Craft a Record Blank — the universal disc template.

Use it in recipes to obtain any of the available discs.

Complete your collection and enjoy the full Minecraft soundtrack without relying only on rare drops.

🌟 Why You’ll Love It
Convenient way to collect all discs.

Expands the musical atmosphere of the game.

Perfect for collectors and fans of Minecraft’s soundtrack.
